Data Platform Engineer
Meridian Analytics, Amsterdam

About the role
Meridian turns retail telemetry into forecasts. You will keep the data platform fast and trustworthy.

Requirements
At least 5 years of data engineering experience.
Production experience with Spark at terabyte scale.
Workflow orchestration with Airflow.
Stream processing experience with Kafka.
Comfort running data infrastructure on AWS.

Nice to have
Infrastructure as code with Terraform.

Responsibilities
Own the ingestion pipelines end to end.
Keep warehouse costs predictable.
Partner with analysts on data contracts.
